about: birolho-1's Personagens Leve (tools/scripts/sprites/quality_copies.py, the rule of 2026-10-25): every clip of cut.json from the same matted frames, at most 36 frames picked evenly (no blend, the clip's timing kept), the figure ~610 px tall (a clip already shorter keeps its own size).
figureNote: measured 2026-11-19: the ball is 342 px in the video = 2.09 units (the old BirolhoLegs2's), so 1 px = 0.00612 units and the idle's figure (807 px) is 4.936 units; every clip's figurePx keeps its own ball that big; the floating clips' floor is their lowest row + 0.32 ball radii (BirolhoLegs' hit video's hover)
